checkpoint.gameMemory: Unsaved game memory excluded; no game input, settings mutation or foreground control

scenario.clients: Five adapter/source-method models; installed and loaded native evidence separate.
scenario.hardware: Shared desktop uncontrolled; wall times are harness runs, not performance acceptance.
scenario.settings: Isolated original-layout object and native event/filter sentinels; real saved settings untouched.
scenario.addons: Actual Core edit helpers, HUD tooltip and optional input diagnostics. Pinned native point overrides/save/enter/exit functions. Remaining widget/event/secret facts modeled.
scenario.warmup: One excluded baseline/candidate process each; five alternating finite scenario pairs.
scenario.phases: Startup; 3save/close cycles with20default-anchor hooks and20direct layout requests per editor; temporary dialog hides; replacement on/off; combat tooltip;4optional captures.
scenario.interpretation: Raw operation counts are bounded desktop dispatch/correctness evidence. Fewer calls do not establish fewer native frame-time spikes. Candidate adds bounded primitive snapshots for selection restoration.
scenario.native: User reports nine secure metadata fields; foreground guard refused commands before first input. Supplied health-color/private-map errors remain native regression targets, not reproduced secret-VM results.
